# Developer — Role-Specific Modules

> These four modules go deep into software engineering with AI assistance. Complete them after finishing the 8 shared modules.

## Module Sequence

| # | Module | Focus | Deliverable |
|---|--------|-------|-------------|
| DEV-01 | [Enterprise Codebase Patterns](dev-01-codebase-patterns.prompt.md) | Naming conventions, error handling, logging, configuration | Documented enterprise patterns with working code |
| DEV-02 | [API Integration Cookbook](dev-02-api-integration.prompt.md) | Authentication, resilience, data transformation | Integration patterns cookbook + reference client |
| DEV-03 | [Testing Strategy for AI Components](dev-03-testing-strategy.prompt.md) | ML pipeline testing, validation testing, continuous monitoring | Test framework for regulated AI systems |
| DEV-04 | [Code Review Agent Design](dev-04-code-review-agent.prompt.md) | Automated style, security, and compliance checking | Code review agent + review checklist |

## How to Use

1. Open the prompt file for your current module
2. Follow the instructions — each module has 4 parts plus a save step and stretch goal
3. Work with Copilot (and the `@developer` agent) to produce each deliverable
4. Save outputs to `personas/developer/workspace/artifacts/`
5. Mark the module complete in `personas/developer/journey.md`

## Prerequisites

Complete the 8 shared modules first. They build the Copilot skills you'll use in these role-specific modules:
- Module 04 (Prompt Engineering) teaches you to write high-quality prompts
- Module 05 (Agent Design) teaches you to build custom agents
- Module 06 (Knowledge Capture) teaches you to structure knowledge for the knowledge base
